content:
version: 1
rules:
  - name: litigation_high_amount
    when: "claim_amount_total_usd is not None and claim_amount_total_usd >= 30000"
    route: "litigation"
    rationale: "High amount >= $30k triggers litigation review"

  - name: severe_injury
    when: "injury_severity == 'severe'"
    route: "adjuster_senior"
    rationale: "Severe injury requires senior adjuster expertise"

  - name: suspected_fraud
    when: "repeat_claims_count >= 2 or any_kw(['staged', 'prior loss', 'inconsistent story', 'suspicious', 'staged accident'])"
    route: "fraud_queue"
    rationale: "Repeat claims or fraud keywords detected - requires investigation"

  - name: low_confidence_handoff
    when: "missing(['claim_amount_total_usd', 'incident_date'])"
    route: "human_review"
    rationale: "Key fields missing or low confidence - manual review required"

  - name: high_amount_senior
    when: "claim_amount_total_usd is not None and claim_amount_total_usd >= 10000"
    route: "adjuster_senior"
    rationale: "High amount requires senior adjuster review"

  - name: property_damage
    when: "incident_type == 'property'"
    route: "property_specialist"
    rationale: "Property claims require specialized handling"

  - name: default
    when: "True"
    route: "adjuster_junior"
    rationale: "No risk signals, standard processing"
